# Infrastructure Migration Report — SQLite → PostgreSQL, Container Topology Cutover

**Scope:** Phase G — canonical container-topology cutover of the PropAura / Rent platform.
**Status:** Code-side cutover complete and statically verified; runtime validation + server-side
legacy retirement deferred to deploy day.
**Canonical source of truth for ports:** `deploy/ports.py` → `deploy/ports.env` (regenerated by `deploy.py`).

---

## 1. Final container topology

| Container | Dev (compose.dev.yml) | Release (compose.prod.yml) | Port(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vite dev server | `propaura_frontend_dev` | — (SPA served by the edge) | dev 28001 |
| API | `propaura_backend_dev` | `propaura_backend_prod` | dev 28002 (expose/host), prod 28011 (expose only) |
| Storage tree | `propaura_storage_dev` | `propaura_storage_prod` | 28003 / 28012 (expose only) |
| PostgreSQL | `propaura_database_dev` (postgres:16-alpine) | `propaura_database_prod` (postgres:16-alpine) | 28004 / 28013 (expose only) |
| Edge nginx | `propaura_nginx_gateway_dev` | `propaura_nginx_gateway_prod` | 28005 / 28014 |
| ngrok | `propaura_ngrok_dev` (profile) | — | dashboard dev 28006 (cont 4040) |
| cloudflared | `gateway/compose.yml` → `propaura_cloudflared` (network_mode host) | same | 80 |

- PostgreSQL and storage are expose-only in both stacks (never published to the host).
- Dev uses a private bridge `dev-net`; prod joins external `propaura-network` so the edge
  can resolve the backend by container name.
- SQLite is fully retired. `postgres:16-alpine` in both stacks; **verify the replica's PG
  major version at 16 before starting the 46 GB restore.**
- `gateway/compose.yml` is cloudflared-only (legacy standalone edge + `propaura_net` removed).
  Cloudflare-side state is untouched — only the local ingress target changes per stack.

## 2. Port map (all 11 canonical)

- Dev: `FRONTEND_DEV_PORT=28001`, `BACKEND_DEV_PORT=28002`, `STORAGE_DEV_PORT=28003`,
  `DATABASE_DEV_PORT=28004`, `NGINX_DEV_PORT=28005`, `NGROK_DASHBOARD_PORT=28006`.
- Release: `BACKEND_RELEASE_PORT=28011`, `STORAGE_RELEASE_PORT=28012`,
  `DATABASE_RELEASE_PORT=28013`, `NGINX_RELEASE_PORT=28014`, `NGROK_RELEASE_PORT=28015` (reserved).
- Verified: `deploy/ports.env` matches `deploy/ports.py` byte-synchronously.

## 6. Deploy-day checklists (server, 192.168.1.50 — not reachable from sandbox)

### 6a. Pre-flight (audit before any deletion)
```bash
docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Ports}}\t{{.Image}}'
docker inspect propaura_legacy_gateway propaura_legacy_backend --format '{{.Name}} {{.NetworkSettings.Networks}}'
# Confirm PG major version on the replica before the 46 GB restore:
psql -h <replica> -tAc "SHOW server_version;"
```
Never run `docker system prune -a`.

### 6b. Dev cutover
```bash
docker network create propaura-network          # prod network (no-op if present)
python3 deploy.py --dev --sshPublic             # regenerates ports.env, provisions env
```
First run will create `pgdata_dev` empty; backend runs `init_db()` (migrations 001 + 002 seed)
at startup, so the dev API comes up with schema + platform admin. Repoint systemd ngrok
(`/home/vega/.config/ngrok/ngrok.yml`) to `http://localhost:28005`. Set
`NGROK_API_BASE_URL`/`VITE_API_BASE_URL` in `.env.development` and redeploy.

### 6c. Release cutover (first time, manual; then automated)
1. Restore the PostgreSQL dump into `pgdata_prod` (verify 16/16-match first); copy
   `storage/release` config, keys, `tenantPin_VAULT_KEY` (legacy value for decryption).
2. Bring up `database_prod` → `backend_prod` (wait for `/health`, 30×3s) → `nginx_gateway_prod` LAST.
3. Cloudflare dashboard: point `api.vijaykrsha.online` at `http://localhost:28014`.
4. Verify `https://api.vijaykrsha.online/health`, then:
```bash
docker stop propaura_legacy_gateway propaura_legacy_backend
touch /home/vega/rent-secrets/RELEASE_READY     # un-gate deploy/self-pull.sh release
```
5. `nginx -t` on the gateway and `bash -n deploy/*.sh` here before or during this run.

## 7. Open risks / follow-ups
- Runtime validation pending: real PG up, `/health` green end-to-end, ngrok → edge split.
- Legacy containers still run until step 6c/4 (by design — zero-downtime flip).
- `gateway/compose.yml` cloudflared reads `CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN` from env/`--env-file`;
  confirm the token is exported where the operator launches it.
- Standalone `backend/compose.yml` header points readers at the canonical dev stack
  (no standalone DB service); its `propaura-network`/`dev-net` split is intentional.
- Restore/pin the Python venv (psycopg 3.3.5 + psycopg_pool) for runtime import checks.
- Future schema changes go into `backend/app/app/db/migrations/0XX_*.py` (versioned),
  not a monolithic `final_schema.py`.
